scope: All matching stats and nested mastery effects in the pinned 3.29.1 Default passive tree. It is not an equipment, item, alternate-tree, Ruthless, or historical completeness catalog.

retention.sourceLicense: The official skilltree-export repository had no declared repository license at the pinned commit.
retention.dataLicense: No affirmative redistribution license for raw game data was established by the inspected source.
retention.provenance: Manually reviewed records transcribed from the pinned official Default-tree export listed in AUD-003.
retention.redistribution: Only minimal factual identifiers, categories, and numeric values are retained; raw export redistribution is not asserted.
retention.derivation: Records are a manual bounded scan result, not a generated copy of the source payload.
retention.attribution: Grinding Gear Games and the exact repository commit, file, and hash are recorded in the source registry and AUD-003.
retention.retainedMaterial: Node/effect IDs, short labels, signed values, and limited classification metadata.
retention.notVendored: Raw data.json, sprites, image assets, full node text, and all unrelated tree records are not vendored.
retention.uncertainty: This does not establish selection multiplicity, arithmetic, target applicability, source completeness outside Default tree, or a game-data redistribution right.

records.limitations: Only the Light Radius term is retained; this record does not prove item or cross-path arithmetic.
records.replacementRule: Replace through a new pinned Default-tree scan recorded in a superseding AUD-003.
